title: VDBE result-column metadata allocation and string ownership

scope.rationale: sqlite3VdbeSetNumCols and sqlite3VdbeSetColName own the pre-execution result-column metadata matrix. Count replacement releases prior Mem values/allocation, allocates COLNAME_N cells per column, and name assignment applies SQLite static/transient/dynamic string ownership.
excluded_responsibilities: Additional COLNAME_DATABASE/TABLE/COLUMN variants disabled by pinned metadata mode
General Mem operations beyond used initialization/text ownership

dependencies.caller_closure: Both active result-column configuration functions, storage fields, and active COLNAME representation are assigned. Public access and final VDBE destruction remain follow-on units.

inputs: Vdbe, nonnegative result-column count; valid column/variant; nullable terminated name and static/transient/dynamic owner strategy
outputs: nResColumn/nResAlloc, COLNAME_N initialized null Mem cells, or configured text cell/result code
contracts.ownership: Replacing count releases every prior Mem value then the matrix allocation. New matrix is connection-owned. Static text is borrowed, transient is copied, dynamic input ownership transfers to the Mem cell.
contracts.state_and_results: Counts publish before fallible matrix allocation and remain set on OOM with null aColName. SetColName indexes idx+variant*nResAlloc. Sticky OOM returns NOMEM before cell access.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Caller holds connection mutex. Dynamic/custom text destructor may run during replacement/final cleanup; no I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Matrix allocation OOM leaves exact counts and null owner. SetColName under sticky OOM returns NOMEM without mutation. Reconfiguration after success releases all prior string owners.

representation_differences: C destructor sentinels SQLITE_STATIC/TRANSIENT/DYNAMIC map to the existing typed Zig StringOwnership union.
Uninitialized Mem fields such as zMalloc are intentionally not observed unless szMalloc establishes ownership.

oracle.protocol: The shared worker creates a Vdbe, allocates two-column metadata, sets static/transient/dynamic names in distinct matrix cells, replaces the matrix with one column, then forces initial matrix OOM and verifies sticky SetColName continuation. C and Zig compare 366 observations.
internal_observations: owned allocation predicate only when szMalloc is active
oracle.normalization: Text contents, pointer identity where contractually meaningful, flags/counts/results and null ownership are exact. Uninitialized non-owning fields are ignored.

assurance.oom: Deterministic matrix-allocation OOM and subsequent SetColName NOMEM are reached; successful replacement releases three ownership strategies.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O; caller mutex and destructor reentrancy remain integration obligations.
assurance.malformed_input: Source assertions constrain column/variant bounds and prior SetNumCols; tests satisfy exact matrix indexing.
assurance.continuation: Successful replacement remains configurable; failed allocation preserves counts and sticky OOM for ordinary statement cleanup.
assurance.performance: One contiguous Mem matrix and direct transposed variant indexing preserve source shape.

integration.native_call_path: Symbolic worker reaches exact Vdbe/Mem/Sqlite3 owners and all active string strategies. Public column APIs and final destruction remain partially handwritten.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: No. Integrate public statement owner and P4-aware teardown.

independent_review.notes: Requires statement/public integration, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Integrate public column metadata access with source Vdbe owner.
Complete P4-aware Vdbe destruction for final matrix cleanup.
